capabilities._note: MiniMax Music 3 hosted on Comfy Cloud through ComfyUI's partner node (ComfyCloudMiniMaxMusic3TextToAudioNode, BETA): a description, lyrics, a seed and a longest length; paid per take, billed to the Comfy API key in Settings (backends.partner sends it with the job). The same model as minimax_music3 (measured there: its words clearest, the tempo not held); empty lyrics set the hosted model's instrumental switch, which the local nodes have no equivalent of. Not run here yet: nothing paid was.

template._note: The node's max_duration (the model can end sooner).

binding._note: The partner node and SaveAudio (an mp3 at V0, converted to wav when it comes back). Its node is marked `_meta.partner`: the local backend sends the Comfy API key as the job's extra_data, and the take is counted against Settings' paid limit (runner.reserve).
